title: The Shadowed Manipulator
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul left only one sentence in the letter—'Tonight at midnight, meet at the old place. There are things about your father's death that I must tell you.'

text.content:
The bamboo leaves rustled in the night wind, Su Qingyao's figure had long vanished into the heavy darkness. Chen Ji stood alone in the depths of the Bamboo Grove, the chill at his spine lingering endlessly, as if an invisible pair of eyes were piercing through the layers of darkness, watching him.

'Your father asked me the same question back then.'

These words were like a poisoned soft blade—seemingly casual, yet striking straight at the heart. Father. Chen Ji's fingers curled slightly, his knuckles whitening from the force. His father had disappeared when he was eight years old, his life or death unknown. For over a decade, he had never dared speak this name before anyone.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) How does she know my father? She's just the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of Tianqing Sect, not even twenty-five years old, and my father disappeared when she probably hadn't even entered the sect... The timeline doesn't match at all!

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. He slowly paced back to his secluded servant's quarters. When he pushed open the door and entered, moonlight filtered through the window lattice, casting mottled light shadows on the ground. He didn't light a lamp, but sat quietly in the darkness for a long while, letting his thoughts surge like the tide.

The暗中相助者. This term had for the first time surfaced so clearly in his mind tonight. Reviewing the various experiences over the past decade—the several crises that should have been fatal yet somehow resolved, those clues that appeared at just the right moments, even the opportunity for him to obtain the Tianji Record Fragment...

He rose abruptly, taking an old wooden box from the hidden compartment beneath the bed. This was the only relic his father had left, the box surface carved with a character he had recognized since childhood—a ancestral Chen family mark, an ancient symbol used to mark important objects.

The box held few items: a letter with faded handwriting, several fragments of灵石 that had lost their spiritual nature, and a broken jade pendant he had always treated as a decorative piece.

dialogue.content: (Gazing at the Jade Pendant) Something's wrong... These patterns on the Jade Pendant don't look like decorative patterns, but more like the base runes of some formation. Father's cultivation wasn't high, how could he have something of this caliber?

text.content:
Chen Ji brought the Jade Pendant close to the moonlight, gazing intently. As spiritual energy slowly circulated through his eyes, those originally vague patterns gradually became clear—it was an extremely concealed tracking formation pattern, its complexity far beyond the crafting level of ordinary cultivators. And in the very center of the formation pattern, there was赫然刻着 a tiny mark.

That mark, Chen Ji recognized.

His pupils contracted sharply. That mark was the private seal his father had always worn at his waist during his life—a bamboo joint pattern carved with a special technique, with three bamboo joints, symbolizing the 'Three Realms' in the Chen family ancestral teachings. But the bamboo joint pattern on this Jade Pendant before him had five joints.

Five-jointed bamboo. Chen Ji's heart missed a beat. Five, in certain esoteric lineages of the cultivation world, represented the extremely high status of 'reaching perfection' or 'transcending the mortal'. His father was merely an ordinary sect disciple—how could he possess something of this caliber?

dialogue.content: (Inner turmoil) Unless... Father's true identity was far from that of a simple ordinary disciple!

choice.prompt: The secret in the Jade Pendant made Chen Ji realize his father's past was far more complex than imagined. How should he investigate this thread of clues?

choices.text: Tracing Father's Archives in the Scripture Library
choices.description: Go to the sect's Scripture Library to review the disciple registry and past records from thirty years ago, searching for traces of his father.
choices.visible_cost: Requires expending energy to avoid patrols
choices.visible_reward: May discover clues about father's true identity
choices.risk_hint: Nighttime movement is easily noticed, may expose investigation intentions

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the Jade Pendant close to his body, draped on an unremarkable Gray Cloth Robe, and pushed the door to vanish into the night. The Scripture Library was located in the central area of Tianqing Sect—ordinary Servant Disciples had absolutely no reason to approach. He had to bypass all patrol routes.

dialogue.content: (Murmuring softly) I mapped out the Scripture Library's patrol times three years ago. Tonight is the time to put that knowledge to the test.

choices.text: First Contact Mo Xiansheng for Answers
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng was father's guardian—perhaps he knows more. First verify with him, then decide on the next move.
choices.visible_cost: Requires expending Tianji Record spiritual energy to communicate
choices.visible_reward: Obtain crucial intelligence, avoid taking detours
choices.risk_hint: Each use of the Tianji Record consumes precious Heavenly Fate

text.content: Chen Ji took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his bosom, his fingertips gently stroking the yellowed paper surface. The ink flickered with a faint light, and a blurry phantom slowly emerged on the paper surface.

dialogue.content: (Remnant soul whispering) You've finally begun investigating... Good, there are indeed some things that should be let known to you.

choices.text: Investigate the Five Elders' recent movements
choices.description: Since the mark of the covert helper is related to Five-Joint Bamboo, the Five Elders must be planning something. First, we need to understand their layout.
choices.visible_cost: Need to take a risk and lurk near the Five Elders' residence
choices.visible_reward: May discover higher powers behind the Five Elders
choices.risk_hint: The Five Elders' cultivation is profound and unfathomable; exposure means certain death

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly in the darkness, a bolder plan taking shape in his mind. Since the Five-Joint Bamboo mark points to the Five Elders, he would trace back along this thread.

dialogue.content: Five Elders... What exactly are you scheming? And how did my father become entangled in this grand game?

text.content:
While Chen Ji was contemplating, he suddenly noticed something hidden beneath the wooden box's bottom. He carefully uncovered the false bottom, and a yellowed letter lay quietly inside. Most of the characters on the letter had faded, but a few key words could still be made out—'Tianji', 'Five Elders', and a name that had been deliberately scratched out but still bore traces.

Chen Ji's breath suddenly quickened. He would never mistake his father's handwriting—this letter was clearly written by his father's own hand, and the 'Tianji' mentioned within... could it refer to the Tianji Record?

dialogue.content: (Fingertips trembling slightly) Father... Who exactly are you? Why have you never told me any of this?

text.content:
At the end of the letter, there was another line of small characters, written even more hastily than the rest, as if penned in extreme urgency—'Ji'er, if you are reading this letter, it means your father can no longer protect you personally. No matter what happens, remember: behind the Five Elders, there is someone. That person...'

The subsequent text was completely blurred, as if deliberately erased by some kind of power.

Chen Ji stared fixedly at those blurred characters, his pupils reflecting an emotion as deep as an abyss. Behind the Five Elders, there is someone. Who is this 'person'? A higher authority within the sect? An Elder above the Three Elders? Or some even more terrifying existence?

He suddenly recalled Su Qingyao's words when she left. 'Your father asked me the same question back then.' — She spoke of 'the same question', so what exactly did his father ask back then? Was it about the Five Elders' conspiracy? Or about that 'person behind the scenes'?

choice.prompt: The father's letter revealed a shocking secret—there is someone behind the Five Elders. Chen Ji needs to decide his next move.

choices.description: The relationship between Su Qingyao and Chen Ji's father is suspicious; perhaps she knows more. Follow and investigate her covertly.
choices.visible_cost: Requires time and may alert the target
choices.visible_reward: Su Qingyao may know the true relationship between father and the Five Elders
choices.risk_hint: She is the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, her strength far above Chen Ji's

text.content: Chen Ji tucked the letter close to his body and vanished into the night. With the concealment techniques he had honed over these years, unless he deliberately revealed himself, ordinary disciples would never detect his presence.

choices.text: Hold position and observe the situation
choices.description: The enemy has already made their move; the more exposed we are, the more dangerous it becomes. Better to wait for the right moment and see how the opponent plays their next move.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity for investigation
choices.visible_reward: Preserve strength and let the enemy reveal more flaws
choices.risk_hint: Passive waiting may worsen the situation further

text.content: After沉吟片刻, Chen Ji finally shook his head. He retreated to the servants' quarters, tightly closing the doors and windows, waiting silently in the darkness. The amount of information tonight was overwhelming; he needed time to sort it out.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) Since you all treat me as a chess piece, then let me see exactly how grand this game truly is.

choices.text: Tracing the Source of the Five-Joint Bamboo Mark
choices.description: Since the benefactor left Father's Five-Joint Bamboo mark, perhaps tracing this mark could uncover more clues.
choices.visible_cost: Must Venture to the Edge of the Sect's Forbidden Grounds
choices.visible_reward: May Discover the True Identity of the Benefactor
choices.risk_hint: The Forbidden Grounds Edge Teems with Peril; a Single Misstep Means Shattered Bones

text.content: Chen Ji took out the Jade Pendant, slowly infusing spiritual energy into the concealed tracking formation runes. The pendant grew slightly warm, and a faint ethereal line pointed toward a location west of the sect—that place, precisely the edge of the Ancestral Masters' Forbidden Grounds.

At that moment, a cold voice sounded from his chest. Chen Ji's expression shifted; he retrieved the Tianji Record Fragment. Upon the yellowed page, ink slowly formed a line of text—

'Tonight at the Hour of Rat, meet at the old place.'

This was Mo Xiansheng's message. Chen Ji recalled that the 'old place' referred to the hidden stone cave beneath the cliff where he had first obtained the Tianji Record—that was where he and Mo Xiansheng first encountered each other.

Chen Ji stared at the inked characters, his heart churning like great waves. Mo Xiansheng was a guardian left by his father, existing as a remnant soul within the Tianji Record, rarely speaking unless necessary. Tonight's sudden summons to meet clearly meant urgent matters required discussion.

The four characters '旧地相见' unmistakably suggested—tonight's discussion would directly relate to the origin of the Tianji Record and his father's past.

The Hour of Rat—just one shichen remained.

choice.prompt: Mo Xiansheng's Sudden Summons Must Hold Hidden Meaning. How Should Chen Ji Respond to This Meeting?

choices.text: Arrive on Time and Confront Directly
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng Must Know Everything of Father's Past; Tonight, the Truth Must Be Clarified.
choices.visible_reward: Completely Unravel the Mystery of One's Origins
choices.risk_hint: The Truth May Prove Heavier Than Imagined

dialogue.content: (Clenching his fist) Father, what exactly did you leave me? Tonight, I must know the answer.

choices.text: Lie in Ambush and Observe Covertly
choices.description: Mo Xiansheng's Intent Remains Unclear; First, Ambush and Observe Whether Others Are Present or Traps Are Set.
choices.visible_cost: May Miss the Opportunity for Direct Dialogue with Mo Xiansheng
choices.visible_reward: Ensure Personal Safety, Avoid Falling into a Trap
choices.risk_hint: Mo Xiansheng Is a Vital Source of Intelligence; This May Cost His Trust

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly as his mind swiftly calculated. Though Mo Xiansheng was his nominal 'Master,' the identity of a remnant soul guardian was inherently shrouded in mystery. Before completely understanding the other party's true nature, rushing to the meeting would be far from wise.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) One must guard against others, even a guardian left by one's father.

choices.description: Before the meeting, make thorough preparations—lay out escape routes, hide backup plans, ensure retreat paths.
choices.visible_cost: Requires Expenditure of Energy to Set Up Contingencies
choices.visible_reward: Retreat unscathed no matter what happens
choices.risk_hint: The preparation time may be insufficient

text.content: Chen Ji took out several talismans from the Hidden Compartment—substitute talismans he had purchased from the black market years ago, capable of blocking one lethal attack at a critical moment. He concealed the talismans close to his body and left marks at several hidden locations along the route.

dialogue.content: (Inner monologue) Even if Mo Xiansheng truly harbors ill intentions, I am confident in my ability to retreat unscathed. This is what it truly means to strategize before acting.

text.content:
The night was as dark as ink as Chen Ji moved through the pavilions and halls of the Tianqing Sect like a specter. Near midnight, he arrived at the hidden cave entrance, concealed by vines—impossible to discover without deliberate searching.

He took a deep breath and stepped inside. The cave was dark and profound, with only a faint spiritual light flickering at the far end—the glow emanating from the Tianji Record Fragment.

The moment Chen Ji stepped into the cave, that spiritual light suddenly brightened. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul manifested on the stone wall, his aged face flickering in the dim light, yet his eyes held an ineffable gravity.

"You have come." Mo Xiansheng's voice was hoarse and low. "I sensed you activated the tracing formation tonight... What are you investigating?"

dialogue.content: (Remnant soul gazing) Do you know that the source of that tracing formation was not left by your father?

text.content:
Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply.

Not left by his father? But the five-joint bamboo mark was clearly identical to his father's personal seal. He unconsciously gripped the Jade Pendant hidden in his sleeve, his thoughts churning like a tide.

If the formation on the Jade Pendant wasn't set up by his father, then what was his father's purpose in leaving this Jade Pendant? How did this secret benefactor obtain his father's mark?

dialogue.content: (Eyes blazing) Mo Xiansheng, you were my father's guardian. You know far more than I do. Since you initiated this meeting tonight, please don't hold back—exactly who was my father?

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul fell silent for a moment, the dim light flickering in his ethereal form. After a long while, he let out a deep sigh.

"Your father..." His voice suddenly became incomparably heavy. "He was the candidate for inheriting the Tianji Record in the previous generation. And the person I was meant to protect... was him."

These words struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind.

Previous generation? Inheritor candidate? Didn't that mean the Tianji Record had already existed in his father's era? And his father was actually a candidate inheritor of this mysterious treasure?

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted slowly across the stone wall, the dim light revealing the complex emotions on his aged face—regret, guilt, and an indefinable sorrow.

"Your father was a prodigy of extraordinary talent." Mo Xiansheng's voice was low and measured. "His aptitude, comprehension, and character were all exceptional. The Tianji Record selected him, considering him the most suitable inheritor. However..."

dialogue.content: (Remnant soul wailing) However, the Eye of Heavenly Dao would not permit it. Every inheritor of the Tianji Record is a thorn in its side. Your father discovered this, and so he made a choice—to voluntarily forfeit the inheritance, leaving the succession rights to you, yet unborn.

text.content:
Chen Ji felt the world spin around him. His father... had voluntarily given up the Tianji Record's inheritance to protect him? But then why did his father disappear? Why was he entangled in the Five Elders' conspiracy?

"As for your father's disappearance..." Mo Xiansheng's voice suddenly turned icy cold. "It is because the forces behind the Five Elders permit no variables. Though your father relinquished the inheritance, he did not abandon his investigation into the truth of the Eye of Heavenly Dao. And the results he uncovered—"

Mo Xiansheng's voice stopped abruptly.

Chen Ji猛地抬头，只见石洞入口处，一道黑影正悄然逼近。那黑影的气息幽深而诡异，仿佛从九幽深处爬出的恶鬼，每一步都带着令人窒息的压迫感。

"墨先生，您今夜说的太多了。"黑影的声音嘶哑而阴冷，"主人有令，关于陈玄的一切，必须永远埋葬。"

Chen Ji's heart sank.

Chen Xuan. That was his father's name. For over a decade, he had never heard anyone speak that name. And tonight, first Su Qingyao, then Mo Xiansheng, and now this mysterious shadow—three different sources, all pointing to the same truth: his father's death was no accident.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently on the stone wall, the spiritual light flickering unpredictably. "Chen Ji, run quickly!" his voice was urgent and anxious. "This person is beyond your capability!"

然而陈机却纹丝不动。

他缓缓抬起头，漆黑的眼眸中映照出那黑影的身形，嘴角竟勾起一抹淡淡的冷笑。十余年的隐忍、十余年的布局、十余年的扮猪吃虎——他从未将自己逼到绝境，也从未让任何人看到过他的全部底牌。

而今夜，他倒要看看，这位'主人'派来的杀手，究竟有几分本事。

dialogue.content:
His voice was terrifyingly calm. "I wanted to wait a bit longer, let you reveal more flaws. Unfortunately, you seem unable to wait. Since that's the case...

Let me see what exactly you want."

text.content:
Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a helpless sigh on the stone wall.

"You child... you're as stubborn as your father." His voice carried a hint of bitterness. "Very well, since matters have come to this, I'll tell you one final thing—"

"Before your father passed away, he entrusted something to me." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul slowly raised his hand, pointing to an inconspicuous rock deep within the cave. "That thing is the key to breaking the Eye of Heavenly Dao. It has been waiting for you to come and take it."

The shadow's form stiffened abruptly, his aura turning even more sinister and cold. "Mo Xiansheng, do you truly intend to betray our master?"

Mo Xiansheng let out a desolate laugh.

"Betray?" His voice carried boundless sorrow. "I was always your father's guardian. My mission was to protect the Tianji Record's inheritance. How could there be betrayal? The Eye of Heavenly Dao merely treats us as chess pieces—do you think it truly values your loyalty?"

Chen Ji didn't turn around, his gaze fixed on the shadow. But in his heart, he was rapidly calculating everything.

His father's final bequest... the key to breaking the Eye of Heavenly Dao... the information was overwhelming, too much for him to digest in a short time. But one thing was clear to him—tonight, whatever the cost, he had to escape this place alive.

The shadow said nothing more, his form exploding into motion. A streak of ink-black spiritual light shot directly for Chen Ji's throat. The speed was terrifying—any ordinary Foundation Building cultivator would be killed before they could react.

But Chen Ji was already prepared.

The moment the shadow struck, a talisman in Chen Ji's sleeve blazed to life. A flash of golden light, and his form left a phantom image in place as his true self vanished three zhang away.

"Substitute talisman?" The shadow's voice carried a hint of surprise. "You've indeed come well prepared."

dialogue.content: (Cold laugh) The substitute talisman is merely one of them. Did you really think that over these past ten-plus years, I was merely playing the role of a useless waste?

text.content:
Chen Ji's voice echoed through the stone cavern with an eerie, terrifying coldness. His fingers flicked gently, and several threads of silver light as fine as hair shot from his sleeve, weaving an intricate, impenetrable net in the air that engulfed the shadow.

Those silver threads were not ordinary projectiles, but beast-binding locks he had obtained by chance years ago, specifically designed to restrict an enemy's spiritual energy flow. Though the shadow possessed Golden Core realm cultivation, caught off guard by this sudden ambush, he was forced to divide his attention.

Seizing this split-second moment, Chen Ji's form flashed as he lunged directly toward the inconspicuous rock deep within the cave.

"Stop!"

The shadow roared furiously, breaking through the silver net by sheer force and striking at Chen Ji's back with a palm. The掌风凌厉，带着足以震碎金丹的恐怖力量。

陈机没有回头。在他的身后，另一道身影悄然浮现——那是墨先生的残魂，用尽最后一丝力量凝聚而成的屏障。

"砰！"

巨响震彻石洞，墨先生的残魂在黑影的攻击下骤然崩散，化作点点幽光消融于虚空之中。

dialogue.content:
(Before the remnant soul dissipates) Chen Ji... remember your father's words... the Eye of Heavenly Dao... what it fears most is not power... but...

His voice cut off abruptly as Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul completely vanished.

text.content:
Chen Ji's hand hesitated the moment his fingers touched the rock.

Mo Xiansheng... just like that, he was gone. The

The rock slowly cracked open, revealing a narrow hidden compartment. Within the compartment lay an ancient jade slip and a thin letter, both resting in silence.

The handwriting on the letter was achingly familiar to Chen Ji—it was his father's script.

'Ji'er, if you are reading this letter, it means your father has already passed from this world.'

Chen Ji's fingers trembled slightly as he unfolded the letter.

'The truth of the Tianji Record is far more terrifying than you could ever imagine. It is not merely a treasure, but a tool used by the Heavenly Eye to select its chess pieces. Every successor has been nothing more than a pawn for it to achieve some hidden purpose.'

'But there is a way to break free from its control.'

The handwriting on the letter grew increasingly erratic, as if the writer was enduring tremendous agony.

'What the Heavenly Eye fears most is "variables." It can predict the future, yet it cannot predict people and events that exist beyond its chessboard. Therefore, to defeat it, one must become a variable outside its game.'

'Your father exhausted his entire life, and finally found a possible method. The jade slip contains an ancient secret technique—the "Reverse Fate Original Yuan Technique." Once successfully cultivated, it can sever all connections to the Heavenly Eye, granting freedom like a bird soaring in the vast sky.'

'But this technique carries enormous risk. Failure means the destruction of both body and soul. Ji'er, your father leaves this to you—whether to cultivate it or not is your decision.'

The black shadow pressed closer once more, palm wind howling as it struck.

Chen Ji didn't hesitate. He grabbed the jade slip and letter in one swift motion, his figure bursting backward. The final substitute talisman in his sleeve activated, his shadow exploding into a cloud of smoke at the original location while his true body burst through another exit of the stone cave.

That exit was an escape route he had scouted years earlier. Over a decade of preparation was finally playing its part.

Night wind rushed against his face as Chen Ji sprinted through the darkness. Behind him came the black shadow's furious roar, but the sound grew increasingly distant.

He had succeeded. After paying the price of Mo Xiansheng's dissolution, he had finally obtained his father's legacy—the jade slip containing the 'Reverse Fate Original Yuan Technique' and the most core secrets of the Heavenly Eye.

But he felt no joy whatsoever.

Mo Xiansheng's voice still echoed in his ears. 'Chen Ji... remember your father's words... the Heavenly Eye... what it fears most is not power... but...'

But what?

Chen Ji stopped in his tracks, turning to look back toward the direction of the stone cave now left far behind. Beneath the moonlight, his face was half-lit and half-shadowed, his expression unreadable.

Tonight, he had learned too much. His father's true identity, the cruel truth of the Tianji Record, the mysterious force behind the Five Elders, and the jade slip that might alter all fates.

This information needed time to process. But one thing was crystal clear to him—from tonight onward, there was no possibility of reconciliation between him and the so-called 'Heavenly Eye.'

It was either you die, or I perish.

He drew a deep breath, tucked the jade slip and letter close to his body, and vanished into the vast darkness of the night.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul had scattered, but his words were like a beacon illuminating Chen Ji's path forward. What the Heavenly Eye feared most was not power, but—

Variables.

His father had proven this with a lifetime of pursuit. And now, this mission had fallen upon Chen Ji's shoulders.

No matter how treacherous the road ahead, he would walk it. For his father's legacy, for Mo Xiansheng's sacrifice, and most importantly—for taking control of his own destiny.

The night deepened as brilliant starlight adorned the sky. Tianqing Sect remained as tranquil as ever, but no one knew that beneath this serene surface, a storm capable of shaking the entire cultivation world was about to arrive.

The next morning.

Chen Ji reported to Tianqing Sect Servants' Quarters as usual, sweeping, chopping wood, carrying water—everything identical to any other day. His expression was平静得近乎麻木, as if last night's heart-pounding ordeal had never occurred.

But in a corner where no one paid attention, his gaze would occasionally sweep across those lofty Inner Disciples, a subtle cold gleam flickering in his eyes.

The force behind the Five Elders... the Heavenly Eye... the truth his father pursued all his life...

These words spiraled endlessly through Chen Ji's mind, weaving a massive net that bound him tightly. But he felt no fear—instead, an unprecedented excitement surged through him.

The larger the chessboard, the more spectacular the game.

He had never been a piece to be manipulated. Since the Heavenly Eye wanted to use him as a chess piece, he would become the one who overturned the entire board.

Just then, a familiar pressure descended from the distance.

Chen Ji raised his head to see a white figure streaking across the sky, ultimately landing in the direction of Tianqing Sect Main Peak. That was where the Inner Disciple Senior Fellow Su Qingyao resided.

The words she had spoken last night still lingered in his heart. 'Your father asked me the exact same question back then.'—How much did she know? What kind of connection existed between her and his father?

Chen Ji's eyes narrowed slightly as an even bolder plan took shape in his mind.

Su Qingyao was not an enemy—at least not for now. Her stance resembled that of a neutral observer, seeking balance between the Five Elders and Chen Ji. And this balance was precisely what Chen Ji could exploit.

He needed an ally, someone who could get close to the Five Elders' core without belonging to their faction. Su Qingyao might be the most suitable candidate.

But before that, he must first uncover the true relationship between her and his father.

Night fell as Chen Ji concluded his day's menial servant work and returned to his secluded cottage. He secured the doors and windows, then取出怀中的玉简, slowly infusing spiritual energy into it.

In an instant, a golden light flashed as the information from the jade slip flooded his mind like a tide—a supremely complex cultivation method, with each step cryptic and difficult, where the slightest carelessness would lead to demonic deviation.

But Chen Ji's eyes blazed with unprecedented fighting spirit.

'Reverse Fate Original Yuan Technique'... The secret art his father spent a lifetime researching... Could it truly sever the connection to the Heavenly Eye?

Just then, a paper crane flew through the window and gently landed in Chen Ji's palm. This was a communication method Mo Xiansheng had taught him before his death—simple yet covert, impossible for third parties to detect.

Chen Ji unfolded the paper crane, which contained only a few brief words:

'Chen Ji, I know you have escaped danger. Regarding Mo Xiansheng's matter, accept my condolences. There are things about your father's death I must tell you. Tomorrow at noon, under the old locust tree at the sect's back mountain, come alone.'

At the signature was a small bamboo leaf mark.

Chen Ji stared at the bamboo leaf mark, his heart churning with waves of shock.

This mark was clearly from the same source as the five-section bamboo pattern on his father's Jade Pendant. Last night, the black shadow had said the 'master'不允许任何人提起陈玄的一切. And now, someone was actually taking the initiative to arrange a meeting, wanting to tell him about his father's cause of death.

Trap, or true ally?

Chen Ji's eyes flickered slightly in the darkness as a meaningful smile curved his lips. Whether trap or opportunity, he would go.

After all, only by standing at the center of the chessboard can one see the entire game's layout.

He tucked the paper crane into his chest, raising his gaze to the night sky beyond the window.

Tomorrow at noon, under the old locust tree at the sect's back mountain. Friend or foe—this mysterious messenger? What past connection did they share with his father? How would the force behind the Five Elders respond to his successful escape last night?

All answers would be revealed tomorrow.

Tonight, Chen Ji needed proper rest to prepare for the challenges ahead. No matter how many dangers awaited him, he would not retreat.

Because his name was Chen Ji.

The talentless disciple whom everyone underestimated, yet who would ultimately overturn the entire chessboard.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul left only one sentence in the letter—'Tonight at the Hour of Zi, meet at the old place, there are things about your father's death I must tell you.' This sentence was like a key, opening the gate to truth sealed for over a decade. When Chen Ji stepped into that old place, he discovered that waiting for him was not only Mo Xiansheng but also an invitation from his father's old acquaintance—tomorrow at noon, under the old locust tree at the back mountain.
